title: Behavioral Linkability of EV Charging Sessions — Analysis Code
description: Complete leakage-controlled evaluation pipeline for the paper 'Behavioral Linkability of Electric Vehicle Charging Sessions in ISO 15118-Enabled Ecosystems: A Privacy–Utility Evaluation': data acquisition (ACN-Data via acnportal), preprocessing, per-user chronological splits, hard-negative pair construction, pairwise verification and candidate-set retrieval attacks, feature ablation, metadata-generalization profiles with operational-utility metrics, figure generation, and an automated leakage test suite. No charging records or user identifiers are included; the pipeline reproduces the study from a fresh download with fixed seed 20260712.
